Allan Chou (周立玮) has established himself as a transformative force in executive education by fundamentally reshaping how future leaders approach sustainable development, corporate innovation, and social responsibility. Serving as a program mentor for Fudan University’s Full-time FMBA and a guest lecturer at the Fudan International School of Finance, Chou pioneered the "Reverse Innovation Path"—a groundbreaking pedagogical approach that shifts the focus from traditional R&D-centric models to downstream application scenarios, ensuring that business strategies are inherently aligned with solving urgent global challenges. His commitment to this philosophy is vividly demonstrated through his global advisory roles with the International Kaleidoscope Challenge (ICC) and the Great SDGs Challenge (presented at the 2022 QS Asia-Pacific Summit), where he actively empowers youth and cultivates independent thinking by guiding the next generation of leaders to analyze and scale impact startups centered on SDG 3 (Good Health) and SDG 13 (Climate Action). Furthermore, through his hands-on mentorship in Social Innovation Acceleration Camps, Chou translates high-level ESG concepts into actionable, circular economy solutions that address real-world issues like plastic pollution. By seamlessly integrating theoretical rigor with practical application, Chou ensures that sustainability and social responsibility are no longer treated as mere compliance metrics, but are rightfully positioned as the foundational drivers of resilient, future-proof corporate innovation.

Allan Chou (周立玮) operates at the nexus of impact finance and frontier technology, leveraging his role as founder of RAIDiCal—an international early-stage fund-of-funds—to strategically steer capital toward Robotics, AI, and sustainable tech that solves real-world challenges. Beyond traditional investment, he integrates financial theory with social responsibility as a professor at Fudan University's International School of Finance where he mentors FMBA and EMF students on embedding ESG and the "Reverse Innovation Path" into corporate strategy. This unique blend of global market insight and hands-on venture expertise allows him to champion a new paradigm of finance where profitability is intrinsically linked to measurable progress on the UN SDGs.
